# Draft:Primaduta Award

----
Primaduta Award is an international trade award presented by the Government of Indonesia through the Ministry of Trade of the Republic of Indonesia. The award is administered by the Directorate General of National Export Development and is intended to recognize overseas importers who have made a sustained contribution to the growth of Indonesian exports.
Established as part of Indonesia’s export promotion strategy, the Primaduta Award acknowledges foreign buyers that demonstrate long-term commitment, consistency, and diversification in importing Indonesian products. As of 2025, the award has entered its twelfth year of implementation.
Background and Definition
The Primaduta Award is designed to support Indonesia’s export growth by strengthening relationships between Indonesian exporters and overseas buyers. One of the key factors in export expansion is the role of loyal importers who continuously purchase Indonesian products and expand the range of goods sourced from Indonesia.
Eligible importers are those that have conducted regular import transactions over a multi-year period and have contributed to increased export volumes, market diversification, and promotion of Indonesian products in their respective countries.
Objectives
The primary objective of the Primaduta Award is to foster long-term trade relationships and networks between overseas buyers and Indonesian exporters. By recognizing committed importers, the program aims to maintain and expand existing trade partnerships in an increasingly competitive global market.
Importer Categories and Qualifications
For the 2025 Primaduta Award, importers are categorized into several groups based on the nature of their business and import activities. Key categories include:
MSME Products Importer
* Import data from the past three years
* Active marketing and distribution of Indonesian MSME products
* Support initiatives for Indonesian MSMEs
* Documented success stories related to MSME product imports
Performing Importer
* Import data covering the past five years
* Number and diversity of Indonesian products imported
* Demonstrated success stories in importing Indonesian products
Service and Digital Goods Importer
* Import data from the past two to five years
* Information on services or digital goods imported from Indonesia
* Relevant success stories
Outstanding Promoter
* Import data from the past three to five years
* Scope of distribution networks and number of outlets
* Promotional strategies and programs supporting Indonesian products
Product Classification
Eligible products include all goods exported from Indonesia and are classified into two major groups:
* Manufactured Products, such as electronics, textiles, chemicals, furniture, automotive products, machinery, plastics, medical equipment, rubber products, handicrafts, leather goods, and essential oils.
* Primary Products, including processed foods, animal products, palm oil and derivatives, fishery products, rubber, base metals, shrimp, jewelry, cocoa products, coffee, spices, fruits, and vegetables.
All product types must be accompanied by a six-digit Harmonized System (HS) code.
Jury and Assessment Process
The Primaduta Award is assessed by an independent jury team composed of professionals and stakeholders, including trade practitioners, academics, journalists, chambers of commerce representatives, and international trade observers.
Selection and verification are conducted by Indonesian overseas representatives, such as embassies, consulates general, trade attachés, and Indonesian Trade Promotion Centers (ITPCs). Verified nominations are submitted to the Directorate General of National Export Development for final evaluation.
Implementation and Awarding
Award recipients are selected based on jury assessment, and the jury’s decision is final. The number of awardees is determined by the Minister of Trade and/or the Director General of National Export Development in consultation with the jury team.
For 2025, the award is planned to recognize up to 60 buyers, consisting of:
* 30 buyers representing industrial and manufacturing products
* 30 buyers representing small and medium enterprise (SME) products
Winners are announced through Indonesian overseas representatives and formally notified to the recipients. The Primaduta Award is presented by the President of the Republic of Indonesia, represented by the Head of the relevant Indonesian diplomatic mission.
